'''Derek Van Beusekom Jabba loves Bounty Hunters''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Derek Van Beusekom]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21723">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21723 Jabba loves Bounty Hunters], DeckTech (Derek "ust66" Van Beusekom, 24 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21723/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21723/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015151112/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21723/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Derek Van Beusekom]]
* '''Published:''' 24 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Jabba loves Bounty Hunters''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Vile Beusekom DS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is a deck I just played at a tourney and went 1-2 (mistakes) but I still like it

== Original post ==

'''Jabba loves Bounty Hunters'''
* '''Author:''' Derek "ust66" Van Beusekom
* '''Published:''' February 24, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is a deck I just played at a tourney and went 1-2 (mistakes) but I still like it

=== Strategy ===

Strategy

Adapt to their Strategy

Control Tat System and Audience chamber

If opponent in space use space persona bounty hunters

Cappture some guys feed them to Sarlacc

Try and use Despair

Set up Tat Occupation

Retrieve some stuff

with Bounties and Scum

Jabba and his cronies at audience chamber

Hunters and mara at others

Not to Complicated
